verdict.rationale: Any public website, including a government tax agency's, could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. Probes show both https://floridarevenue.com/llms.txt and the markdown variant of the reemployment docs page return HTTP 404. The 'agents' named in the docs are human tax agents, not AI agents, and the XML schemas and batch specs are not agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
